demo.title: fomofam-workflow.sh
demo.code:
# Verify session (needs FOMO_REFRESH_TOKEN env var)
node scripts/fomo.mjs whoami

# Trending + token lookup
node scripts/fomo.mjs trending
node scripts/fomo.mjs search PEPE

# Buy $10 of a Solana token (signed with FOMO_PRIVATE_KEY)
node scripts/fomo.mjs swap buy <mint> 1399811149 10

# Post a public thesis on a token you trade
node scripts/fomo.mjs thesis <mint> 1399811149 "accumulating, liquidity looks real"

setup: Add `FOMO_REFRESH_TOKEN` env var (fomo.family DevTools -> Application -> Local Storage -> privy:refresh_token)
Add `FOMO_PRIVATE_KEY` env var (base58 Solana secret key of the FOMO account wallet)
Recommended: add `FOMO_PROXY_URL` residential proxy — Cloudflare 403s datacenter IPs
Run via execute_cli with packages [cycletls@2.0.5, @solana/web3.js@1.98.4, tweetnacl@1.0.3, undici@8.10.0] and filesFromSkill fomofam
